_comment: Demo 2.0 (protocol revision 10): account progression for the game client -- coins and account XP per match, account levels, daily / weekly missions and the cosmetics store. Coins are earned by playing, never bought. Format: net/include/w2f/net/Progression.h, docs/network-protocol.md 'Progression'.
